method: Read-only bounded September 29 cron_job_audit SELECTs; scalar substring extraction from truncated stored response strings; no API invocation.

queries.news-window-id-search: SELECT job_name, count(*) AS receipt_count, min(run_time) AS first_run, max(run_time) AS last_run, bool_or(position('cac51da7-3f50-4109-b7b4-3ad80538f07f' in COALESCE(details->>'response','')) > 0) AS barzal_item_referenced, bool_or(position('4795b0c8-d119-4977-9b77-45e040224e25' in COALESCE(details->>'response','')) > 0) AS soucy_item_referenced, bool_or(position('2104976276528542197' in COALESCE(details->>'response','')) > 0) AS barzal_relay_referenced, bool_or(position('2104996083462271476' in COALESCE(details->>'response','')) > 0) AS soucy_relay_referenced FROM public.cron_job_audit WHERE (run_time >= '2026-09-29T16:58:00Z' AND run_time < '2026-09-29T17:05:00Z') OR (run_time >= '2026-09-29T18:28:00Z' AND run_time < '2026-09-29T18:35:00Z') GROUP BY job_name ORDER BY job_name LIMIT 30;
queries.news-publisher-response-literals: SELECT job_name, run_time, status, rows_affected, length(details->>'response') AS response_chars, position('"success":true' in COALESCE(details->>'response','')) > 0 AS response_success_literal, substring(details->>'response' FROM '"dryRun":(true|false)') AS dry_run_literal, substring(details->>'response' FROM '"rowsLoaded":([0-9]+)') AS rows_loaded_literal, substring(details->>'response' FROM '"insertedCount":([0-9]+)') AS inserted_count_literal, substring(details->>'response' FROM '"updatedCount":([0-9]+)') AS updated_count_literal, substring(details->>'response' FROM '"publishedCount":([0-9]+)') AS published_count_literal, substring(details->>'response' FROM '"assignmentsSynced":([0-9]+)') AS assignments_synced_literal FROM public.cron_job_audit WHERE job_name='/api/v1/db/auto-news-feed-items' AND ((run_time >= '2026-09-29T16:58:00Z' AND run_time < '2026-09-29T17:05:00Z') OR (run_time >= '2026-09-29T18:28:00Z' AND run_time < '2026-09-29T18:35:00Z')) ORDER BY run_time LIMIT 10;
queries.news-publisher-timing: SELECT job_name, run_time, details->>'durationMs' AS duration_ms, details->'timing' AS timing, substring(details->>'response' FROM '"inference":\{"enabled":(true|false)') AS inference_enabled_literal, substring(details->>'response' FROM '"model":"([^"]+)"') AS inference_model_literal, substring(details->>'response' FROM '"promptVersion":"([^"]+)"') AS inference_prompt_version_literal FROM public.cron_job_audit WHERE job_name='/api/v1/db/auto-news-feed-items' AND ((run_time >= '2026-09-29T16:58:00Z' AND run_time < '2026-09-29T17:05:00Z') OR (run_time >= '2026-09-29T18:28:00Z' AND run_time < '2026-09-29T18:35:00Z')) ORDER BY run_time LIMIT 10;

source.publicationBehavior: Current source retains an existing published_at or stores candidate.publishedAt; invocation nowIso is captured once. Current source is not proof of the September 29 deployed version.

limitations: Initial broad discovery was limited to 40 records and stopped before the second publication window; the recorded grouped exact-ID query covers both separate seven-minute windows without this limitation.
Exact item and relay tweet IDs were not present in the inspected retained responses. Those responses may omit later samples because they are truncated.
Scalar fields are regex captures from stored JSON text, not a complete parsed response. Null captures mean unavailable, not false or zero.
Batch inserted/updated/published/assignment counters do not identify which exact items changed; publishedCount is not proof of that many newly published items.
Exact timestamp equality supports identifying candidate publisher batches, but is not an explicit item-to-run foreign key, original output replay or immutable source revision.
The configured model label is not evidence of model use; the captured inference.enabled literal is false.
The prompt version is not a code commit, deployment ID, full effective configuration manifest or current processor parity receipt.
Stored audits and the current database item captures are not certified immutable.
No News acceptance gate or paused upstream classification task was closed; no writer, cron trigger or production change ran.
